component.name: CDPlayer
component.summary: A music player that feels like a real CD player

description.p: CDPlayer plays your local music, your audio CDs, YouTube Music and SoundCloud, and with Spotify Premium your Spotify albums, the way a CD player would. No account and nothing else to install: MP3, M4A/ALAC, FLAC, WAV, AIFF, AU, OGG and Opus play out of the box.

ul.li: The disc spins in its jewel case with your cover printed on it, catches the light and wears scratches as you play it
The CD shelf: every album in your music folder spine-out, dust on the ones you never play, new ones shrink-wrapped
The booklet: the tracklist, lyrics and credits, marked in pen as you play
Lyrics and karaoke, each word of an English song timed to the singer's voice, offline
Audio CDs played, or ripped to tagged FLAC in one click
Player looks, colour themes, a phone remote, and share cards and videos of what's playing

screenshot.caption: The player in CD changer mode, five discs in the carousel
The CD shelf, every album spine-out
The ALBUM look: the album in its jewel case, the disc sliding out
Karaoke, the line filling in word by word as it's sung
